transforms.ssm_a: GGUF stores -exp(source A_log), reordered with value heads
transforms.ssm_dt_bias: GGUF stores source dt_bias, reordered with value heads
transforms.ordinary_rmsnorm: GGUF stores 1 + source offset weight; multiply by the stored scale directly
transforms.gdn_gated_rmsnorm: GGUF preserves the source linear_attn.norm.weight; multiply by the stored scale directly
transforms.convolution: source [channels, 1, width] is squeezed to GGUF [width, channels]
